notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing lands except Weaver of Harmony, one of which must be a Forest.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Wilderness Reclamation triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control except Weaver of Harmony by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Wilderness Reclamation's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Wilderness Reclamation's trigger, untapping all lands you control and tapping all lands the defending player controls.
Repeat from step 2.
